digest.component_or_area: LLM gate cost analysis and ordinal-to-binary migration planning
propositions: Mean per-ticket cost is $11.85 (median ~$8.15, p90 ~$21) with per-gate means of $3.02 (plan-review), $1.42 (code-review), $2.24 (completion-verifier).

Code-review severity axes are inert because 98.2% of findings route to non-blocking with blocking_enabled=False, and the 0.95 threshold is unreachable (only 7/432 ordinal combinations achieve it, all requiring the rare conjunction blast_radius=system AND likelihood=high AND reversibility=hard, observed zero times in 3,738 gradings).

Cheap-model experiments (Nova Pro, Haiku, Nova 2 Lite) validated verdicts with Nova Pro achieving ~30-40x cost reduction ($0.07-0.09 vs $2.31-3.00) but recalled only 50-57% of blocking criteria; Sonnet retained for completion-verifier at 22/22 gold-set accuracy versus Haiku 19/22.
Phased ordinal-to-binary migration plan (Phase 0-3) documented with validation boundaries; execution remains separate work requiring operator approval.

Two observability.sh probe defects identified: cold-start seeding inflates marker counts (widespread-zealous-narwhal) and over-broad pattern matching confuses review text for errors (colossal-slothful-grouse), causing false-positive alarm firings.

Deprecation removal audit found nothing expired under policy; only the retired .gitattributes migration arm (15 LOC) is removable now; single-pass review surfaces and REBAR_LLM_MODEL are candidates for next pre-1.0 breaking window.
